# Vendored FullCalendar

Generated from npm packages pinned to **FullCalendar 7.1.4** (MIT), bundled as
one IIFE plus one stylesheet so the static Capsule needs no network access:

- `fullcalendar.min.js` — `fullcalendar` v7.1.4 (`Calendar`, dayGrid, list,
  Pulse theme, `temporal-polyfill`) compiled with Vite.
- `fullcalendar.css` — `skeleton.css` + `themes/pulse/theme.css` +
  `themes/pulse/palettes/blue.css` from the same version.
- `LICENSE.md` — FullCalendar's MIT license text.

Reproduce the bundle with the versions and entry shown in
`docs/ops/oss-quick-start-calendar-fullcalendar-20261111.md` in `ato-run/ato`.
